verdict.rationale: Abacum's dedicated Excel connector page says users can "push and pull data seamlessly between Excel and Abacum," which is the bi-directional Excel workflow the story asks for. Support is a single marketing line with no technical depth. missing for 10: documentation of the add-in mechanics (live refresh, write-back validation, permissions on push), any Google Sheets add-in, independent or hands-on corroboration.
